content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Law graduate; Active as an Advocate for at least seven years; Income tax payer for a period of at least 5 years before appointment Experience: At least seven years active as an Advocate Age limit: 35 to 60 years Other conditions: Must be active as an Advocate for at least seven years Must be an income tax payer for at least 5 years before appointment

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fee and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officer (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Affairs Rules, 2026. Panel to be prepared under Section 18(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 Appointee can serve up to a maximum age of 60 years

content_sections.text: Interview Candidates called for interview must attend at their own expense with original certificates at the fixed date, time and place

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form Attested copies of certificates of date of birth, experience, educational qualification and caste Copies of income tax returns of the last 5 years Copy of Sanad (enrolment under Section 17 of the Advocates Act, 1961) Certificate from the court where practice started Recent passport-size photograph, pasted and signed

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Tapi Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form from https://tapi.nic.in/notice_category/recruitment/. Fill in complete details in the form and paste a recent passport-size photograph signed by the candidate. Attach attested copies of certificates of date of birth, experience, educational qualification and caste. Attach copies of income tax returns of the last five years. Send the application only by Speed Post so that it reaches the office by 21-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be considered

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Tapi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Tapi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for District Public Prosecutor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Tapi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Office website https://tapi.nic.in/notice_category/recruitment/; format also attached to the notice) and send it to Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Block No. 2, Collector Office, Jilla Seva Sadan, Panvadi, Vyara, Dist. Tapi-394650, by speed post only, to reach by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 to 60 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fee and other allowances as per the Gujarat Prosecuting Officer (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Affairs Rules, 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Law graduate, active as an Advocate for at least seven years, and an income tax payer for at least 5 years before appointment.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be active as an Advocate for at least seven years. Must be an income tax payer for at least 5 years before appointment.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Candidates called for interview must attend at their own expense with original certificates at the fixed date, time and place.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Panel to be prepared under Section 18(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023. Appointee can serve up to a maximum age of 60 years.

faq.answer: District Court, Tapi District (Gujarat).
